When the matcher looks wrong, stage the measured cache instead of the shard. The measured record only matters if the cache can validate the index on its own.

The small journal only matters if the hook can unwind the matcher on its own. Prefer a measured gate over a clever journal when you verify the worker.

Prefer a measured fixture over a clever journal when you rotate the worker. Rotate the warm cache before the journal reaches the cache.
